speaker: Raj
text: There's the house I found America's top models. Are you sure? Look on the roof, Anais and Giselle are sunbathing. European style. Of course not. I got a buddy of mine at NORAD to have a spy drone fly over.

speaker: Leonard
text: You can recognize people on Google Earth? NORAD? You're using military aircraft?

text: It's a military target that poke around a nuclear reactor in Siberia. It took it an hour out of its way, tops.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sheldon? I just dropped him off at the comic book store, what?

text: Okay, where is he? Here, try and go online. Just try.

speaker: Raj
text: Greetings, hamburger toucher. You're probably wondering why you cannot IM your little friends about how much you've parked various things.

speaker: Raj
text: Well, this recorded message is alerting you that I am putting an end to your parasitic piggybacking upon our Wi-Fi. If you want to remedy the situation, you can contact the phone company, set up your own Wi-Fi and pay for it, or you may apologize to me.

speaker: Leonard
text: I reiterate, you're not the one.

text: Oh, no, no, no, no, it is on. I am getting your future friends in the world occurred.

speaker: Leonard
text: Well, Penny, you don't want to get into it with Sheldon. The guy's one lap accident away from being a super villain.

speaker: Penny
text: I don't care. I was in junior rodeo. I can hot time castrate him in 60 seconds.

speaker: Raj
text: No need to neuter the nerd. I can get you back online.

speaker: Raj
text: Voila. Hello, puny insects. As a consequence of your efforts to circumvent my will, everyone is awarded one additional strike.

speaker: Raj
text: What are you complaining about? I'm the one who has to take the class.
